assumptions: The dye halves at each division and the channel is acquired on a log (decades) scale, so generations are evenly spaced on it.
The parent file holds the same cells labelled alike and left unstimulated; its peak is generation 1.
limits: At most 20 generations; one width is shared by every generation.
Shares integrate the fitted model, so overlapping generations are split by the model, not by gates.
bio.jane/contract.question: How many divisions have these dye-labelled cells gone through, and what share sits in each generation?

description: flowFit's division-dye model (CFSE, CellTrace, PKH26): a Gaussian fitted to a project file of unstimulated (parent) cells, then the stimulated file fitted by nls.lm as one Gaussian per generation a dye halving apart (position, width or spacing optionally held); each generation's %, flowFit's proliferation index and Roederer's indices.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

fix_distance.description: hold the spacing at one dye halving.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

population.description: a population, gated in both files; empty for all.

name: fit_flow_cytometry_proliferation

fit.description: the parent fit, the fitted and held parameters, spacing, iterations, deviance and the proliferation index; null when refused

generations.description: per generation: centre, rounded cell count and % of cells; null when refused

indices.description: Roederer's division-tracking indices over flowFit's counts; null when refused
